faq3Q: Is it legal to download videos with mediasaver?

faq4Q: What video quality can I download?

faq5Q: Can I download videos on my phone?
faq5A: Yes. mediasaver works on any device with a browser — mobile, tablet, or desktop.
faq6A: Some videos may be private, age-restricted, or removed by the uploader, which can prevent downloading. Try a different public video link, or check that the URL was copied correctly.
